source_title: Diljit Dosanjh teams up with reggaeton legend Daddy Yankee for ‘Pokito’
source_excerpt: Punjabi star Diljit Dosanjh has joined forces with Puerto Rican reggaeton legend Daddy Yankee for a new international single, âPokitoâ. The song mixes Punjabi and Spanish lyrics, while the music video, directed by Stillz, reflects the musical identity of both artists. The release marks another big step in Diljitâs growing global journey.Punjabi and Latin sounds blend in âPokitoâThe track moves smoothly between Punjabi lines and Spanish reggaeton verses, giving each singer space to show his own style. Diljit Dosanjh opens the song in Punjabi before Daddy Yankee enters with his well-known Latin flow. Although two languages are used, both sounds keep their original flavour. Punjabi music and reggaeton rarely share the same song, which makes this pairing stand out.A repeated hook, âPoquito a poquitoâ, which means little by little, ties the verses together. Daddy Yankee speaks about his journey and the struggles behind his success, while Diljit brings his Punjabi swagger. His verses focus on attitude, reputation and the larger-than-life image often linked to Punjabi music.He repeats the line, âHaan chalda Na Chalda Mitran da billo thaa chaldaâ, which highlights his confidence and influence. The song then builds towards the playful chant, âOhh Yankee Jatt, HH HATJAA PICHE AH YANKEE JATTâ, placing both artists in the same musical space.Music video shows two cultures side by sideThe video, helmed by Stillz, goes beyond the music. It shows the singers in colourful locations, including a brightly lit baseball stadium and a convenience store. Diljit is seen in his trademark turban with different looks, ranging from a denim jacket to a white traditional outfit. Daddy Yankee sticks to his signature style, wearing baseball jerseys, leather jackets and dark sunglasses.The visuals play on the contrast between Punjabi cultural elements and Latin urban influences. Instead of keeping the two styles apart, the video merges them through its locations, costumes and overall look. This gives the collaboration its own identity and adds to its cross-cultural appeal.Diljit Dosanjh set to begin Aura tour in IndiaMeanwhile, after his international gigs, Diljit starts his Aura tour in India on October 30. The tour will then move to Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Bengaluru and Chandigarh, among other places.
